title: Douglas Lenat: Cyc and the Quest to Solve Common Sense Reasoning in AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #221
summary: Lex Fridman interviews Douglas Lenat, founder of Cyc, a decades-long project to encode common-sense knowledge and reasoning for AI. They discuss symbolic AI and how it may complement neural networks.
why: Pointed to as the long-form interview for understanding Lenat's work, especially after his death.

quote.text: If anybody wants to hear more about Doug's work and ideas, here is a (fairly long) interview with Doug by Lex Fridman
